name: Tryykarifinte
source: designed from the NTHF text (no puck.no picture); PROPOSED, for the user's review
text: Right wing carries the puck quickly forward in the slot with the heel groove (Edwall drag), stops before the goal line, turns 180 degrees counterclockwise and shoots with the heel into the goal
note: User review 2026-11-27 (Edwall-innspill, applied to every heel-groove carry): in the heel groove the figure is turned with the stick about 45 deg toward the right boards, the puck touching only the skate and the stick heel (never through the stick).
